name: Schedule a contact window
description: Reserve antenna time and configure the ground station for an upcoming satellite pass.

name: Execute a routine pass
description: Run a scheduled contact end-to-end: acquire signal downlink telemetry uplink commands release.

name: Handle a missed pass
description: Detect a failed acquisition and automatically rebook the next available contact window.

name: Command a constellation broadcast
description: Send one validated command sequence to many satellites over successive passes.

name: Prioritize emergency contacts
description: Preempt the contact schedule when a spacecraft declares a fault condition.

name: Monitor pass in real time
description: Watch live telemetry and link quality during a contact with alerting on limit violations.

name: Trend spacecraft telemetry
description: Plot any telemetry channel across weeks or months and overlay related channels.

name: Detect telemetry anomalies
description: Flag unusual telemetry patterns automatically for engineer review.

name: Manage alert thresholds
description: Define and version the limit sets that trigger caution and warning alerts.

name: Review fleet status at a glance
description: See health rollup of every satellite on one dashboard with drill-down.

name: Investigate a fault timeline
description: Reconstruct the sequence of events telemetry and commands around an anomaly.

name: Generate health reports
description: Produce recurring fleet health summaries for the program office.

name: Plan an orbit maneuver
description: Design a delta-v maneuver with fuel estimate and updated ephemeris products.

name: Screen for conjunctions
description: Ingest external tracking data and warn on close-approach events.

name: Maintain orbit knowledge
description: Update orbit determination from ranging and telemetry after each contact.

name: Generate pointing products
description: Compute antenna pointing and pass geometry files for each site and pass.

name: Coordinate maneuver with partners
description: Share planned maneuvers with external agencies and deconflict timing.

name: Ingest new mission payload data
description: Receive process and catalog payload downlink data with quality checks.

name: Task payload collection
description: Build and validate a payload tasking request against constraints then schedule uplink.

name: Deliver products to users
description: Package and distribute finished data products to subscribed consumers.

name: Reprocess archived data
description: Re-run processing over historical raw data after algorithm updates.

name: Monitor processing backlog
description: Track queue depth latency and failures across the data processing chain.

name: Manage data retention
description: Apply retention and archival policy across raw and derived data stores.

name: Authenticate an operator
description: Log in with enterprise credentials and hardware token.

name: Authorize by crew position
description: Enforce role-based command authority: which console can send which commands.

name: Audit all commanding
description: Keep a tamper-evident record of every command sent by whom from where.

name: Manage cryptographic keys
description: Load rotate and destroy comsec keys across ground and space segments.

name: Detect ground intrusion
description: Alert on suspicious activity across ground segment networks.

name: Train a new console operator
description: Run guided practice scenarios against a simulated spacecraft.

name: Certify crew proficiency
description: Track completion of certification requirements per crew position.

name: Rehearse anomaly procedures
description: Exercise the crew against injected fault scenarios and score the response.

name: Maintain operational procedures
description: Author review and version the procedures the crew executes.

name: Execute a procedure interactively
description: Step through an approved procedure with auto-verification of expected telemetry.

name: Hand over between shifts
description: Capture shift notes open items and watch conditions for the incoming crew.

name: Manage configuration baselines
description: Track approved versions of ground software databases and spacecraft tables.

name: Update ground software
description: Roll out ground segment software updates through test and into operations.

name: Failover to backup site
description: Transfer operations to the alternate ops center with minimal contact loss.

name: Plan integrated operations
description: Merge contact payload and maneuver plans into one deconflicted fleet timeline.

name: Model what-if scenarios
description: Branch the operations plan and compare resource impacts before committing.

name: Publish the daily ops plan
description: Distribute the approved plan to all consoles and external partners.

name: Track plan execution
description: Mark planned activities complete slipped or failed as the day unfolds.

name: Replan after an anomaly
description: Rebuild the remaining daily plan quickly when an anomaly consumes resources.

name: Forecast resource contention
description: Project antenna and crew loading weeks ahead to spot bottlenecks.

name: Onboard a new satellite
description: Register a new spacecraft its database and its constraints into ground systems.

name: Decommission a satellite
description: Retire a spacecraft from operations and archive its full history.

name: Manage ground station inventory
description: Track antenna and equipment status maintenance windows and capabilities.

name: Coordinate external ground time
description: Request and manage contact time purchased from partner networks.

name: Measure fleet utilization
description: Report on contact time payload duty cycle and capacity headroom per satellite.

name: Support launch and early orbit
description: Run the intensive contact cadence and checkout sequence after launch.

name: Transfer satellite control
description: Hand a satellite to or from another operations organization with full records.

name: File and track ops incidents
description: Report ground segment problems and track them to resolution.
